Our Story

Vision

Born from Passion

Fenix emerged from a deep understanding of what live casino players truly want — genuine human connection, professional expertise, and immersive environments that feel like the world's best land-based casinos, available anywhere.

Founded by a team of iGaming veterans, Fenix has grown from a boutique studio consultancy into the industry's most comprehensive live dealer solution provider, operating studios across three continents.

The Fenix Team

Our 500+ professional dealers represent the finest talent in live gaming. Rigorously trained in game procedures, player engagement, and on-camera presence, they are the face of your brand in every session.

Multilingual fluency across 10+ languages gives Fenix the ability to speak directly to players in every major market worldwide.

Our Technology

Fenix operates proprietary streaming infrastructure built from the ground up for live casino environments. From 4K camera arrays to AI-assisted dealer scheduling, every element of our technology stack is purpose-built.

We deliver 99% uptime guarantees backed by multi-CDN redundancy and real-time monitoring across all active studios.

Our Vision

To make world-class live dealer experiences accessible to every casino operator — regardless of size, geography, or budget. We believe the future of casino gaming is live, immersive, and human.

What Is It?

Shared Tables,
Zero Overhead

Table Sharing lets you place your brand on our existing Fenix-operated live tables — without building, staffing or managing anything yourself. Your players see your logo, your colours, your feel — while we handle every operational detail behind the scenes.

It's the fastest and most cost-effective path to a live casino product. Ideal for operators who want to test markets, launch quickly, or maintain a live presence without the commitment of a dedicated studio.

FAQ

Frequently Asked
Questions

Everything you need to know about working with Fenix. Can't find the answer? Contact us directly.

General
What is Fenix Live Dealer Studio?
+
Fenix is a full-service live dealer studio management company. We design, build, staff, and operate professional live casino environments for iGaming operators worldwide — providing everything from custom table design and 4K streaming technology to certified multilingual dealers.
Where are your studios located?
+
Our flagship studios are in Malta and Tbilisi, Georgia. We also provide studio management services for operator-owned facilities across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
What games do your dealers cover?
+
Our certified dealers are trained across all major live casino games: Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Poker variants, Sic Bo, Dragon Tiger and game show formats.
How quickly can we go live?
+
For shared studio setups, onboarding typically takes 4–8 weeks. For dedicated studio build-outs, timelines range from 3–6 months depending on scope. We assign a dedicated project manager from day one.
Do you offer white-label solutions?
+
Yes. Our full white-label service means everything your players see — dealer uniforms, table graphics, studio branding and streaming interface — carries your brand identity exclusively.
What is Fenix's uptime guarantee?
+
We guarantee 99% uptime across all active studio feeds, backed by multi-CDN redundancy, 24/7 technical monitoring, and rapid-response support. SLAs are customised per partnership agreement.
How do I get started with Fenix?
+
Simply reach out through our Contact page or click "Book a Demo" anywhere on the site. Our partnerships team will respond within 24 hours to schedule a discovery call and understand your studio requirements.

Still Have Questions?

Our team is available 24/7 for existing clients and within 24 hours for new inquiries.
